stock.description: Huisen Household International Group Limited, established in 2005 and based in Ganzhou, People's Republic of China, is a manufacturer and distributor of furniture. The company supplies a broad spectrum of products for residential, office, and commercial environments within China, and also engages in international exports. Their core business involves producing panel and metal furniture, frequently under original design manufacturing (ODM) or original equipment manufacturing (OEM) agreements. The extensive product range encompasses common panel furniture items like TV cabinets, bookshelves, desks, and coffee tables, as well as upholstered sofas and outdoor recreational furnishings. Furthermore, Huisen manufactures sports and leisure equipment such as table tennis and pool tables, and supplies particleboards.
